task: Edit this rate-limit reference paragraph to add the correct time denominator and counting scope from the supplied facts. The input states the number of allowed requests but omits the per-minute window and per-key scope.
input: The API enforces a rate limit of 500 requests. Exceeding the limit results in a 429 response.

facts.text: The rate limit is 500 requests per minute.
The limit is counted per API key.
Exceeding the limit results in a 429 Too Many Requests response.
The Retry-After response header specifies when the current window resets.

forbidden_additions: An invented retry count or fixed backoff interval not from the facts.
preserve: 500 requests per minute per API key.
Retry-After header as the source of window-reset timing.
